$comment: Accepted ARCH-009 Schema Version 1.0.0 under issue #42 and Owner / Final Authority acceptance comment 5208715683. Schema validity grants no contract conformance, approval, authority, trust, acceptance, release, deployment, merge permission, or access permission.
title: CNTX Common Artifact Envelope
description: The common identity, governing-definition, provenance-reference, and optional digest-evidence boundary for one CNTX Artifact Instance. This schema evaluates the envelope object only; artifact-specific payload and relationship semantics remain outside this resource.

provenanceReferences.description: Optional source pins. Their presence identifies sources but does not assign artifact-specific relationship meaning or authority.

contentDigests.description: Optional digest evidence. A digest does not grant identity, provenance, authority, approval, trust, or conformance.

opaqueString.description: A non-empty opaque string containing at least one non-whitespace character. Its lexical form grants no authority or semantics beyond the governing contract.

semanticVersion.description: An exact MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH version without leading zeroes, prerelease text, build metadata, or an implicit component.

artifactType.description: The canonical CNTX Artifact Type. This token does not encode authority, classification, lifecycle, status, or governing-definition identity.

artifactInstancePin.description: The stable identifier and exact revision of one logical Artifact Instance.

contractDefinitionPin.description: The stable Contract Definition Identifier and exact Contract Definition Version governing the Artifact Instance.

schemaDefinitionPin.description: The stable Schema Identifier and exact Schema Version governing the represented Artifact Instance.

artifactReference.description: A revision-pinned Artifact Instance source reference without relationship or authority semantics.

contractDefinitionReference.description: An exact Contract Definition source reference without authority semantics.

schemaDefinitionReference.description: An exact Schema Definition source reference without authority semantics.

referenceTarget.description: Exactly one artifact, contract-definition, or schema-definition source pin.

contentDigest.description: Digest evidence associated with an exact subject pin and an explicitly declared opaque method.
